note: Credential + API-access layer for the GA Reports project. Owns config google_analytics_reports_api.settings (property = GA4 numeric property id, json = private managed-file id of the service-account key, cache_length = query cache seconds, default 259200). Exposes the GoogleAnalyticsReportsApiFeed service (static service(), isAuthenticated(), __call proxy to Google's BetaAnalyticsDataClient with per-query caching), library google/analytics-data. Permission administer google analytics reports api; route google_analytics_reports_api.settings at /admin/config/services/google-analytics-reports-api. Real data needs an external Google service, so evals are grounded in local config values only (cache_length, property) via cset/cget - no entity saves.

evals.prompt: Where does the google_analytics_reports_api module store its Google Analytics 4 connection settings, and what are the main config keys it saves?
evals.expected_output: Config object google_analytics_reports_api.settings (edited at /admin/config/services/google-analytics-reports-api). Keys: property (GA4 numeric property id), json (private managed-file id of the service-account credential), cache_length (query cache seconds, default 259200).

evals.prompt: I want to run a Google Analytics 4 report query from custom code using google_analytics_reports_api instead of writing my own OAuth. Which service class do I use and how do I check it is connected?
evals.expected_output: Use GoogleAnalyticsReportsApiFeed::service() to get an authenticated feed, check $feed->isAuthenticated(), then call Google Analytics Data API methods (it proxies to BetaAnalyticsDataClient via __call and caches results for cache_length seconds).

evals.prompt: Which permission controls the google_analytics_reports_api settings form, and why does the module cache query results?
evals.expected_output: The permission 'administer google analytics reports api' gates the settings form. Results are cached for cache_length seconds (default 3 days) because Google's Analytics Data API enforces a daily query quota.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Google Analytics Reports API query cache has been configured to a non-default duration. Inspect the live configuration and give the cache length in seconds.
On this Drupal site, which Google Analytics 4 property id is configured for the google_analytics_reports_api module? Inspect the live configuration and report it.
On this Drupal site, change the Google Analytics Reports API query cache length to 7 days (604800 seconds) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set google_analytics_reports_api.settings:cache_length to 604800, e.g. `drush cset google_analytics_reports_api.settings cache_length 604800 -y`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Google Analytics Reports API module to use the GA4 property id 123456789 (set the property in its settings config) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set google_analytics_reports_api.settings:property to 123456789, e.g. `drush cset google_analytics_reports_api.settings property 123456789 -y`.
